archetypes.name: diagnostics
archetypes.rationale: Diagram failure details now flow through multiple artifacts and KV output.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 7a and pr_body changes for durable, redacted diagram failure diagnostics. Check non-fatal behavior, one-line DIAGRAM_REASON formatting, stale failure-log handling, and run-log copy timing around rebase failures. Verify no raw secret-bearing stderr can land in committed artifacts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: prompt-contract
archetypes.rationale: The /bug prompt contract now parses --urgent and delegates title-prefix behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review skills/bug/SKILL.md plus the structural harness for prompt-side ambiguity. Check that repeated leading --urgent tokens, non-urgent leading -- tokens, empty-description validation, and exactly one /issue --title-prefix value remain clear and executable by an agent. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
